changes: Independent MFA and device-list reads with visible errors and separate safe controls.
Compact full-width cards/table, setup countdown, password/code autocomplete and explicit current-device guidance.
Synchronous mutation exclusion, uncertain-result reread, password clearing and retained setup after read failure.
MFA enrollment, confirmation, other-login closure and audit are atomic; account and pending secret are checked under row locks and the shared account session lock.
Enabled MFA cannot be replaced by enrollment; disabling still requires the current password and code. Existing shorter passwords can be verified without applying new-password length rules.
A renewed current login stays open while other login families close; revoked/inactive/foreign sessions cannot change MFA.
